# EduMojo

EduMojo is a simple, affordable school ERP (school management software) built by Webmagiks. It cuts teachers' day-to-day work by up to 40% by handling attendance, homework, report cards, parent updates and timetables in one easy app, with admissions, fees, transport, library and hostel for the office. It is used by 15+ schools, colleges and institutes in India and Dubai. Tagline: 'Up to 40% less work for teachers, every day.'

## Three Brand Pillars
1. Saves teachers' time
2. Simple to use
3. Affordable for every school

## Modules
- Attendance & Parent Alerts
- Homework & E-Learning
- Marks & Report Cards
- Timetable & Substitutions
- Fees & Payment Links
- Smart Assistant & Automation
- Admissions & CRM
- Parent / School App
- Transport & GPS Tracking
- Library Management
- Certificates & Documents
- Staff & Payroll
- Examination Management
- Inventory & Assets
- Student & Staff ID Cards
- Visitor & Gate Pass
- Hostel & Boarding
- Alumni Network
- Academic Reports
- Online Fee Collection
- Daily Academic Updates
- Student 360 Profiles
- Multi-Branch Institute Management
- Custom Form Builder
